<details open>

cuda : fuse qwen4exp's SCALE -> SIGMOID -> SCALE -> hc_post chain (#30602)

Port of the Vulkan HC_POST_GATE fusion (#29520). hc_combine builds the
hc_post weights as 2*sigmoid(inject/hc); dsv4_hc_post_f32 now takes a
gated template flag and computes scale_out*sigmoid(scale_in*p) from the
raw weights, so the chain runs as one kernel instead of four.

</details>
